PRIMARY_FIRST_FAILURE_MECHANISM: ANY_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE OR ANY_MODEL2_EVIDENCE (including PROFILE_DOMAIN soft hits) → WHOLE_PATHFINESPAN_ANCHOR without evidence-sufficiency or phonetic-coverage check; granularity collapsed to boolean
ONE_NEXT_DELTA: Modify only Anchor materialization (model3-anchor-adapter.ts / evidence-sufficiency contract) so Anchor requires span-level sufficient explanation, not boolean ANY domain/model2 evidence; do not change Model2 transforms, Domain Vote, FineSpan, Model3 weights, Retry, or Stage-2.

codeChain.predicate: domainOk OR model2Ok → whole PathFineSpan Anchor

domainOk.producer: base lexicon domain_term recall AND/OR Model2 materializeDomainHits (PROFILE_DOMAIN with source=domain_term)
domainOk.semanticMeaning: ANY geometrically bound retained-domain domain candidate exists

model2Ok.producer: expand-windows-with-model2 / candidate-materialize (P hits + D soft hits)
model2Ok.semanticMeaning: ANY Model2-provenance candidate bound to span
model2Ok.NOT: Model2 pronunciation transform fully explains span

profileDomainDualTrigger.effect: sets source=domain_term AND retrievalProvenance=PROFILE_DOMAIN → same candidate flips domainOk and model2Ok

codeChain.hiddenAnchorSources: NONE beyond DOMAIN / MODEL2 / DOMAIN_AND_MODEL2 in this adapter
